$comment: C07 exg-pmt-bre-tax constraint hints. The buyer REQUIREMENT leaves (minimum-amount threshold + additional information) carry EA cardinality 1, so the generator would mark them required. But they encode the OPTIONAL de-minimis derogation of Article 57(2), 2nd subparagraph of Directive 2014/24/EU ('Member States MAY provide for a derogation ... where only minor amounts ... are unpaid'). The ESPD Annex 2 questionnaire does not even include a buyer threshold field, and no Schematron rule requires it. So relax both to OPTIONAL via optionalLeaves — the buyer sets a threshold only if their Member State applies the derogation. This flows to both the form (not required) and the instance-data schema (not in `required`), keeping the two layers in step.
